meta.geometry_method: Original WGS84 polygon boundary intersections with positive length (rook); area-weighted local projected polygon centroids; haversine spherical great-circle centroid distances
meta.distance_units: km; straight-line centroid distances, not travel distances
meta.centroid_projection: local constant cos(50.5 degrees) longitude scaling; centroid transformed back to WGS84
meta.graph_interpretation: Connected components induced within existing parent clusters. Radius graphs permit chaining; diameter reports the largest pair distance. UNASSIGNED is excluded, never grouped together.
meta.correlation_interpretation: pearson/spearman use saved robust clipped first differences; raw_delta_pearson uses count first differences; rate_delta_pearson uses unshrunk per1000 first differences; residual_pearson uses modeled first differences minus regional unshrunk rate first difference.

geometry_crossvalidation.interpretation: Display simplification is checked by exact common edge endpoints; original positive-length boundary intersections remain authoritative. Segment splitting may explain display-only differences.
